summary_en: 700,000 shares (3.13% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), up to ¥2.0B, execution window Aug 12–Sep 7, 2026. Rationale: enhance stock value and shareholder returns; execute flexible capital policy in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notification of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 3 August 2026, CAWACHI LIMITED's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 700,000 treasury shares (3.13% of the 22,334,247 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate price of ¥2.0 billion, within the execution window 12 August–7 September 2026. The acquisition will be conducted pursuant to the Companies Act, Article 165(3), read in conjunction with Article 156. The stated rationale is to enhance stock value, expand shareholder returns, and execute flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. As of 15 March 2026, the company held 2,249,173 treasury shares.
